answer: Each identity binds one registered saffron-field plot whose crocus rows ripple purple. The registry maps one plot to one identity; no plot backs two identities. Bees draw nectar from its flowers; the dried saffron is sealed in the cooperative vault under its number and audited yearly. Faking one identity locks 4,100 units for 180 days plus 140 units in fees, spent not returned; 100 fakes: 410,000 units locked 180 days, 14,000 units in fees. Cheapest cheat: lease a fallow plot, 850 units per 180 days, or bribe a clerk 1,400 units to register one polygon twice; both fail the audit.
